# Asset provenance and licensing

**Every model, texture and sound in this repository is original work generated by scripts in this repo.** No third-party model, texture, font file (other than the two fonts below), audio recording or music is bundled.

| Asset group | Files | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Playable characters (3, rigged, 16 clips each) | `src/assets/models/char_*.glb` | `tools/assets/{loft,chargen,outfits,characters,rig,build_characters}.py` | Project (original) |
| Spectators (12 posed variants) | `crowd.glb` | `tools/assets/{crowd_lib,build_crowd}.py` | Project (original) |
| Vehicles, Okada, generator | `veh_*.glb`, `gen_generator.glb` | `tools/assets/{build_vehicles,vehicles_lib,veh_*}.py` | Project (original) |
| Pillars, soft blocks, walls, bleacher, buildings, kiosk, lamp, poles, tyres, barrels, sign | `prop_*.glb`, `env_*.glb` | `tools/assets/{build_environment,env_*}.py` | Project (original) |
| Floor slabs | `src/assets/textures/floor_*.jpg` | `tools/assets/build_textures.py` | Project (original) |
| Sound effects, engines, horns, crowd ambience and reactions | synthesised at runtime, nothing stored | `src/audio/` (DSP in `src/audio/dsp`, recipes in `src/audio/recipes`) | Project (original) |
| Display font "Anton" | bundled by `@fontsource/anton` | Vernon Adams / Google Fonts | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| Body font "Barlow Condensed" | bundled by `@fontsource/barlow-condensed` | Jeremy Tribby | SIL OFL 1.1 |

Notes
- Names on signs, posters, plates and destination boards ("MAMA PUT", "OSHODI", "LAGride", ...) are invented for this project. No real brand, logo or trademark is intentionally reproduced.
- **The crowd and engine audio are synthesised stand-ins. They are not recordings of Nigerian crowds, buses or music and must not be described as authentic.** A manifest (`public/audio/slots.json`, see `public/audio/README.md`) lets licensed recordings replace any sound; each entry must state a licence, and `public/audio/LICENSES.md` must be kept current.
- Regenerating any asset is deterministic: see `docs/ASSET_PIPELINE.md`.
